decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed cabinet and antennae, so far as is practicable, should be sited so as to minimise its effect on the external appearance of the area.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed cabinet and antennae shall be removed from the land on which it is situated, as soon as reasonably practicable after it is no longer required for telecommunication purposes, and such land be restored to its condition before the development took place, or to any other condition as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: The removal of 3 no. O2 antennas from the existing telecoms mast at Brentford FC, to be replaced by 3 no. antennas which are joint use VF/O2 antennas, and the addition of 1 no. cabinet of less than 2.5 cubic metres
